stories.title: IMF和世行年会将在曼谷举行 泰国加强安保和城市保障

en.title: IMF and World Bank Annual Meeting to be held in Bangkok; Thailand strengthens security and city readiness
en.summary: The 2026 IMF and World Bank Group annual meeting will take place in Bangkok from October 12-18. Thai authorities are enhancing security, transportation, flood prevention, and urban services to ensure the conference proceeds smoothly.

en.title: Chinese Super League Round 27: Chengdu misses title chance with last-minute defeat; Qingdao relegated
en.summary: In round 27 of the 2026 Chinese Super League, leaders Chengdu lost 1-0 to Tianjin in injury time while second-place Dalian won 4-0. Qingdao was mathematically relegated after losing 0-3 to Beijing.

stories.title: 波黑前部长会议主席：中国以长远眼光谋划未来

en.title: Former Bosnian Council of Ministers Chairman: China approaches the future with a long-term perspective
en.summary: Zlatko Lagumdzija, former chairman of Bosnia and Herzegovina's Council of Ministers, stated that while China's development attracts global attention, what impresses him most is China's long-term thinking amid rapid global changes.

en.title: "Yuan Rice Think Tank" intelligent hybrid rice breeding platform launched in Changsha; AI empowers breeding innovation
en.summary: An intelligent hybrid rice breeding platform has been launched in Changsha, marking a shift from traditional experience-based methods to data-driven and intelligent decision-making approaches in Hunan's hybrid rice breeding.

en.title: Former Australian Prime Minister Kevin Rudd: Calls for building an equal and open Asia-Pacific community
en.summary: Former Australian Prime Minister Kevin Rudd stated in Beijing that Asia-Pacific members should manage differences and expand cooperation despite existing variations and competition, working together to build an equal and open community.

en.summary: The inaugural China·Dunhuang International Wushu Open commenced in Gansu Province, attracting more than 2,000 athletes from over 20 countries competing in the event themed around cultural heritage and martial arts.

en.title: Former Thai Foreign Minister: Welcomes Chinese mediation in Thai-Cambodian border conflict
en.summary: Thailand's former foreign minister expressed at a dialogue forum in Shenzhen that he welcomes China's role in mediating Thai-Cambodian border disputes, stating both nations should respect China's goodwill gestures.

en.title: WTT China Grand Slam: Wang Manyu defends women's singles title, China table tennis finishes with two championships
en.summary: China's Wang Manyu successfully defended her women's singles title at the WTT China Grand Slam by defeating Japan's Sato Hitomi 4-0, while Japan's Matsushima Teruki won the men's singles championship.

en.title: Saudi-led coalition says Riyadh airport terminal attacked
en.summary: A Saudi-led military coalition spokesman reported that an unidentified projectile struck terminal 4 of King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on October 11, causing a fire that authorities are addressing.

en.title: 2026 Shanghai Masters: Zhou Yi loses to Humbert, all Chinese singles players eliminated
en.summary: Chinese wildcard Zhou Yi fell to Dutch player Herbert Humbert 1-2 in the Round of 32 at the 2026 Shanghai Masters, ending China's singles participation in the tournament.

en.summary: Nearly 100 participants from China, Cambodia, and Thailand, including think tank scholars and civil society representatives, gathered in Shenzhen on October 11 to advance consensus from the Fuxian summit.

en.title: Trump says Russia, Ukraine agree to 'energy ceasefire'
en.summary: US President Trump announced that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to halt strikes on each other's energy infrastructure, though Ukraine's leader stated the news was unexpected to him and Russia did not immediately comment.

en.title: Chinese brokers work to crack the final code: win clients on global stage
en.summary: Chinese investment banks have shifted their strategy from simply copying Goldman Sachs to developing their own globally competitive institutions, aligned with President Xi Jinping's 2023 call for cultivating first-class investment firms.

en.title: Apple's Tim Cook kicks off China visit amid mixed signals on new iPhone demand
en.summary: Apple's Tim Cook is visiting China for the third time this year following the iPhone 18 Pro and first foldable iPhone Duo launches, meeting with Guangdong's governor and signaling willingness to expand manufacturing and sales operations.

stories.title: New vs old: why new-builds are far outselling used homes in Hong Kong

en.title: New vs old: why new-builds are far outselling used homes in Hong Kong
en.summary: Hong Kong's property market shows diverging trends with new-build home sales surging while secondary market recovery remains modest. Developers are cutting prices on new properties to reduce inventory ahead of anticipated interest rate increases.

stories.title: Japan’s Sumitomo Bakelite expands China chip packaging materials output amid AI boom

en.title: Japan's Sumitomo Bakelite expands China chip packaging materials output amid AI boom
en.summary: Sumitomo Bakelite is expanding production of advanced chip packaging materials at its Chinese and Singapore facilities to meet rising demand from the artificial intelligence sector. This represents the company's second major capacity announcement in China within four months.

stories.title: As clock ticks on China’s commercial land leases, renewal plans allay investors’ concerns

en.title: As clock ticks on China's commercial land leases, renewal plans allay investors' concerns
en.summary: Guangzhou and Shanghai have announced new land renewal policies for commercial and industrial properties that aim to stabilize the market and restore investor confidence. These measures are expected to support real estate financing tools including exchange-traded investment trusts.
